payload.comment: Profiling stage is clean and internally consistent. PathMNIST (9-class, 28×28 RGB, 3-channel) is correctly identified with split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) matching the official MedMNIST distribution exactly; no subsampling. Archive MD5 cross-checks against verified_archive_md5; SHA-256 is present. Class counts sum correctly to split sizes (train: 89996, val: 10004). Imbalance ratio of 1.63 is modest and class proportions are near-identical between train and val, indicating no split-level distribution shift. No blank images, no duplicate train samples. Ambiguity risks (background/debris/mucus overlap, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, etc.) are well-documented and expected at 28×28 histopathology resolution. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is appropriately flagged for OOD context. Two minor, non-blocking observations: (1) llm_model_digest is null for ollama qwen3.8, so the exact model revision is not pinned—this slightly weakens full reproducibility of any LLM-assisted steps but does not affect the deterministic pipeline; (2) test_imbalance_ratio is reported as 1.0 and test_to_train_prevalence_ratio is empty, consistent with the test split not being individually profiled in this stage (only train+val = 100,000 samples were profiled). Neither constitutes a deterministic finding. No issues warrant revision or stop. Proceed to the next stage.
